Class TakeFoodAction

java.lang.Object
model.board.OfferTileAction.TakeFoodAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
OfferTileAction
public class TakeFoodAction extends Object implements OfferTileAction
Implements the "Take Food" strategy for offer tile actions. This action immediately grants a specified amount of food to a player when they land on an offer tile with this action. The action is completed upon entry, as no additional interaction (such as card drawing) is required.

  • Method Details

    • onEnterAction

      public void onEnterAction(Player player, GameModel model)
      Executes the food distribution when a player enters this offer tile action. Immediately adds the specified amount of food to the player and marks this action as finished, since no further interaction is required.
      Specified by:
      onEnterAction in interface OfferTileAction
      Parameters:
      player - the player landing on this offer tile
      model - the current game model (not used for this action)

    • canDraw

      public boolean canDraw(Card card, RowsManager rowsManager)
      Determines whether a card can be drawn in this action. This action does not support card drawing; it only distributes food.
      Specified by:
      canDraw in interface OfferTileAction
      Parameters:
      card - the card to evaluate (not used)
      rowsManager - the rows manager (not used)
      Returns:
      always false as card drawing is not permitted in this action

    • performDraw

      public void performDraw(Card card, RowsManager rowsManager)
      Executes a card draw operation. This action does not support card drawing, so this method performs no operation.
      Specified by:
      performDraw in interface OfferTileAction
      Parameters:
      card - the card to draw (ignored)
      rowsManager - the rows manager to update (ignored)

    • isFinished

      public boolean isFinished()
      Determines whether this action has been completed. Since food is distributed immediately upon entry, this action is always finished after onEnterAction(Player, GameModel) is called.
      Specified by:
      isFinished in interface OfferTileAction
      Returns:
      true as this action completes immediately upon entry

    • accept

      public void accept(OfferTileActionVisitor visitor)
      Accepts a visitor for processing this action. Implements the Visitor pattern by dispatching to the visitor's visitTakeFood method.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:
